root_cause: 23,295 stored connections included 605 email addresses, but none carried the explicit contact-level human_approved marker required by existing autonomous email sender; action queue had no currently prepared eligible email.
prevention: Review contact email authority for every canonical connection each business day in bounded batches through the original heartbeat.
Separate eligibility for evaluation from authorization to send; missing approval must remain blocked.
Retain independent channel owners, suppression and contact pressure checks, exact provider readback and deduplication.

evidence.source: canonical Supabase connection store and sender code inspection
